text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The curtain falls on the Spring Tenno Sho! 
What a truly magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek shows off a magnificent run, 
even more commanding than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what in the world!? Where is this 
ridiculous strength coming from—!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the!? I was the one who crossed 
the finish line first. But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Her running has even more intensity than 
mine... What in the world is this power—?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is... Creek... This is that Super 
Creek everyone talks about...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No. That ain't the Creek I know. ...But 
I've seen that look somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I see. So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she was able to run like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's okay now. Really, it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Heh. A magnificent run, Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You truly are my lifelong rival.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, there are two "Tenno Sho" races. 
—Spring and Autumn. Kyoto and Tokyo, 
cherry blossoms and autumn leaves, man and 
woman.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In the autumn 'Tenno Sho', Oguri Cap will 
be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—Hm, was that not it? Was that not the 
right vibe?”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Well yeah, you're right. Don't go 
getting all serious out of nowhere, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, in her spring showdown against 
Tamamo Cross, Super Creek achieved an 
admirable result.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, why was Super Creek so completely 
carefree today?
